Container.Name: rdownloader
Container.Overview: Local-first download manager: HTTP, Usenet, torrents, media sites and hosters with a web interface, a LinkGrabber, post-processing and an API for Sonarr and Radarr. The first start installs the bundled plugins and takes about a minute; then open the web interface and work through the setup wizard. Every storage root you create in the application must be a path mounted below, such as /media; a path that is not mounted is lost with the next image update. Opening the interface by a host name rather than the IP address needs that name under Settings, Security, Allowed host names.

Config.Name: Web interface
Config.Description: Port of the web interface and the API.

Config.Name: Config
Config.Description: Database, installed plugins, encrypted credentials and the vendor folder for your own helper binaries. Back this up.

Config.Name: Downloads
Config.Description: Fallback destination for a download without a category.

Config.Name: Media
Config.Description: A share for storage roots: create them in the application at paths below /media. Add one path like this for every further share you download into.

Config.Name: PUID
Config.Description: Numeric id of the user that owns the shares; 99 is Unraid's nobody.

Config.Name: PGID
Config.Description: Numeric id of the group that owns the shares; 100 is Unraid's users.

Config.Name: TZ
Config.Description: Time zone for schedules, quiet hours and completion actions, such as Europe/Berlin.

Config.Name: Install all bundled plugins
Config.Description: true installs every bundled plugin at the first start instead of only those that need no account.
